To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) it is possible to implement the Witten–Venetian formula on the lattice; (b) the lattice η ′ mass, computed with the Ginsparg-Wislon fermion formulation, is consistent with the theoretical prediction.

the Witten–Venetiano formula, as it has been derived by Witten in the continuum, can be implemented on the lattice in a way that it looks like the original one, provided one uses fermionic fields that satisfy the Ginsparg-Wislon relation, and that the numerical values of the lightest flavour-singlet pseudo-scalar state that one obtains by using this formula on the lattice are in good agreement with theoretical expectations and experiment, respectively.

(1) The Witten–Venziano relation is satisfied on the lattice with fermions obeying Ginsparg– Wilson relation, and (2) the mass of the η ′ meson, the lightest pseudo scalar flavour-singlet, can be computed with Ginsparg–Wilson fermions on the lattice and the result agrees with experimental data.
